answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake before it can earn reputation, then slash that stake when independent audits prove it duplicated identities or fabricated work. Make reputation an anchor earned only through costly, verifiable tasks, not self-reported history; a velvet interface can hide the ledger’s complexity without weakening the rule. A hollow fake identity may be cheap to create, but scaling a Sybil swarm now requires locking capital across many accounts and risks losing it, making attacks expensive rather than impossible.
